newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Petro to issue debentures.
newsitem.headline: Thai Petro to issue debentures.

text.p: Thai Petrochemical Industries Plc said on Friday that it planned to issue up to $250 million in convertible debentures to expand business and capital.

Thai Petrochimical said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that the bonds will have a maturity of up to 10 years and their coupon and terms will be decided closer to the issue date which has yet been set.
The firm said its capital will be raised to 21.7 billion baht from 19.6 billion after an issue of 210 million new shares being reserved for future conversion by debenture holders.
Thai Petrochemical is one of Thailand's leading companies with domestic and regional interests in petrochemicals, plastics, energy and building materials.
